# Bitácora.btc

> Open collaborative map of Bitcoin communities, nodes and merchants in Latin America. Education, events and on-chain pulse. No custody, no exchange.

Bitácora.btc is a community logbook (bitácora) run by Consciencia Bitcoin from Colonia del Sacramento, Uruguay, with LATAM Cripto Mom. It helps people find Bitcoin circular economies nearby and learn self-custody.

## Site

Canonical: https://bitacorabtc.org/

- Home: https://bitacorabtc.org/
- Map / globe: https://bitacorabtc.org/#mapa
- Consciencia Bitcoin: https://bitacorabtc.org/#conciencia
- Community & events: https://bitacorabtc.org/#comunidad
- News pulse: https://bitacorabtc.org/#pulso
- History of Bitcoin: https://bitacorabtc.org/#historia
- Network data: https://bitacorabtc.org/#red
- Market: https://bitacorabtc.org/#mercado
- FAQ: https://bitacorabtc.org/#faq-seo
- Contact: https://bitacorabtc.org/#contacto

Languages: Spanish (default), Portuguese, English (`?lang=es|pt|en`).

Map search: `https://bitacorabtc.org/?q={city-or-community}#mapa`

## What it is not

Not an exchange, wallet, broker or custodian. It does not hold keys or user funds. It is not bitacorabtc.com (unrelated).
